messages:
maria: FYI planning a kernel + quant-profile rollout tonight 23:00 PT. Owners: @jamie (lead), @tara (canary smoke). Plan: staggered canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Need quick sign-off on smoke checklist.

jamie: I can lead. timeline works. what's target slice size for canary?

tara: I'll run canary smoke. prefer 10 hosts, 15m window. bringing the smoke checklist:
- run `curl -sS https://ingress.prod/health | jq .` on canary
- watch p50/p95 token latencies in console (route: /model/gpt-medium)
- confirm ML model outputs for 5 golden prompts (see pinned gist)
- verify no regressions in generation length distribution

keshav: Add: confirm KV cache warmup using `rictl cache peek gpt-medium:kv` and verify miss rate drops to <5% after warmup. Also check GPU memory headroom on each slot.

maria: Good call. Also fallback plan: automatic fallback to quant-v1 when kernel panics; manual rollback via `rictl rollback --slot <prev-slot-id>`; rollback window: 30m after final stage. Escalation: ping #eng-oncall and @sre-lead if >2% errors.

lee: Quick Q: are we changing quant profile globally or per-model? If global, infra needs a restart and extra 10m.

jamie: per-model 'gpt-medium' only. No infra restart. quant profile name: qfp-2026-03-17. Will tag the model config with that profile before canary.

tara: Smoke checklist ready. I'll post results in this thread. tagging @ops-bot to create deployment ticket.

ops-bot: Deployment ticket created — DT-2026-871. Scheduled window: starts 1978884000 (23:00 PT), expected end 1978887600. Notifying on-call and reserve 2 standby engineers.

maria: Thanks. Last ask: code-review owners, any pending reviews for the runtime shim? @jamie

jamie: Merged yesterday. no blocking CRs; CI green. Canary image tag: infra/engine:v2.14-quant-qfp-2026-03-17

tara: I'll start the canary at 23:00 PT. Running smoke steps every 5m and posting summary like: `OK p50: 42ms, p95: 210ms, golden-prompts: pass 5/5, errors: 0.3%`

maria: perfect — thanks team. If anything unexpected, call rollback early and ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

jamie: one more quick note — monitoring dashboard ready at https://console.redwood/prod/dashboards/engine-rollouts. Alerts: runtime-error-rate and model-quality-regressions enabled.

tara: copying final preflight commands for whoever runs the canary:
```
# before enabling traffic
rictl slot claim --model gpt-medium --slot canary-01
rictl deploy --slot canary-01 --image infra/engine:v2.14-quant-qfp-2026-03-17
# smoke (run on control host)
curl -sS https://ingress.prod/canary/gpt-medium/health | jq .
```

maria: all set. will leave this thread pinned. good luck and ping if you need a hand.
